However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates a) Up-to-date GCC Service- 20.03.2018 of Indian Railway and other rules, regulation, guidelines regarding management of contract from time to time will also be applicable in this contract. b) Minimum Eligibility Criteria, Evaluation of technical & financial criteria of this Gem bid shall b e as per Tender Document attached. c) Bidder has to mandatorily submit an affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/- (Duly Notarized) for an eligible applicant as per. (Appendix-5) d) Bidder has to submit Power of Attorney as per prescribed format. (Annexure-10) e) Bidder has to submit T1-Turnover: as per prescribed format (Appendix-17) along with audit ed balance sheets. The financial data in the prescribed format shall be certified by chartered accountant with his stamp, signature, UDIN number and membership number. Also f) Bidder has to submit T2-Liquidity as per prescribed format (Appendix-13) g) Bidder has to submit Bid Capacity Criteria: as per prescribed format (Appendix-18 & App endix-19) in the prescribed format shall be certified by chartered accountant with his stamp , signature, UDIN number and membership number. Also. h) Bidder's offer shall be summarily rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / docu ments sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Forms of EMD Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sr. DFM, Nor thern Railway, Lucknow payable at Lucknow. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of th e DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.

4. Forms of PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Deman d Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr. DFM, Northern Railway, Lucknow payable at Lucknow. After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 30 days of award of contract. .
